purpose: Teach: 収まっ/再考/議案/見合う/後進/特派/拍車/名乗っ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業績、本気で、ようやく、収まってきたな、絶対、社員、本気で、頑張ってくれた、本気で、感謝、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: Our performance is finally settling down. The staff has worked genuinely hard. I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Measured, controlled delivery. Measured approval — the words land with quiet authority. A moment's pause between clauses, giving weight to the gratitude.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来期方針、本気で、再考、進めてまいります、絶対、本気で、よりよい、戦略、目指してまいります、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We'll move forward with a thorough reconsideration of next term's policy. We're aiming for a stronger strategy.
lines.style: Formal and steady. Professional cadence — each phrase deliberate. Respectful posture in the voice. Slight forward lean of commitment on 'thorough reconsideration'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今回の議案、本気で、社員、皆、賛成、絶対、お父さんの代から、続く、当社の、伝統だ、絶対、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: This proposal has the full support of the staff. It continues a tradition that goes back to my father's time. That's the way we do things here.
lines.style: Authoritative but not cold. Clear-eyed certainty on the legacy reference. Slight warmth underneath — pride in continuity. Unhurried pacing, grounded.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。投資、本気で、リスクに、見合う、リターン、絶対、確保、目指してまいります、本気で、絶対、頑張ります。
lines.en: Yes. We're examining investment options that will secure returns matching the level of risk. We're committed to that.
lines.style: Careful precision. Each technical phrase lands cleanly. Professional respect in the tone — not defensive, just thorough. Steady eye-level delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 後進の育成、本気で、急務だ、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、社員、皆、頑張れ、本当に、これは、絶対、頼んだぞ、絶対。
lines.en: Developing the next generation is urgent work now. I'm counting on you all. Push forward with this.
lines.style: Firmer register — command without harshness. Weight on 'urgent'. The tone shifts slightly, more direct. Expectation is clear but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外特派員、本気で、設置を、検討しております、絶対、お得意様に、お応えできる体制、本気で、整えます、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently looking into establishing an overseas correspondent position. We want to be ready to serve our valued clients better.
lines.style: Informative and measured. Professional update cadence — he's reporting back as much as committing. Slight uptick on 'serve our valued clients', showing that piece matters to him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の競争、本気で、当社、絶対、拍車を、かけていけ、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、本当に、これは、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: The competition in our industry is intensifying. Our company needs to stay ahead. I'm asking you to make this happen.
lines.style: Driving urgency without raising volume. The pacing quickens slightly on 'intensifying'. Sharp, clear delivery — this is not a suggestion. Compressed, purposeful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新部署、本気で、責任者、名乗ってくれる方、社内、絶対、本気で、見つけてまいります、本当に、絶対、頑張ります、本気で。
lines.en: Yes. We're actively seeking someone from within the company who will step into the new department head role. We will find that person.
lines.style: Closing confidence. Steady, resolved tone. A touch of determination on 'we will find'. Professional closure — he's answering the call. Shoulders back, committed posture in voice.
